audience: insurance agencies that run sales, service and client follow-up in AgencyZoom

useCases.title: See the sales leads and their assigned producers
useCases.text: Search the sales leads with filters. Read the status, stage and assigned producer of each lead, and match the producer ids with the employee list.

useCases.title: Find a customer and list the policies
useCases.text: Search customers by name. Open a customer to read the contact data, then list the policies with carrier, premium, dates and status.

useCases.title: Review the tasks that are past due
useCases.text: Search the tasks for the past-due period and read who owns each one. Open a task to read its notes and the lead or customer it belongs to.

useCases.title: Log a call and create a follow-up task
useCases.text: Add a note with the outcome of a call to a lead. Then create a follow-up task for the same lead. AgencyZoom may notify the assignee.

useCases.title: Move a lead to the next pipeline stage
useCases.text: Read the pipeline stages and the lead first. Then move an active lead to another stage. The move refuses leads that are already won, lost or x-dated.

useCases.title: Check sales against the goals
useCases.text: Read the dashboard sales summary for the agency or one producer. See the goals, month-to-date sales and the daily premium for the period.
